problemStatement: A text-only continuity state resolved before PIT replay selection cannot prove that continuity certification applies to the exact selected PIT revisions/session set consumed by the factor engine.
minimalBuildLaneDelta: Build the RAW PIT replay window before resolving continuity.

Derive an immutable exact selected-window identity from the chosen PIT revisions/session set. Preserve existing replayHash and add/derive sourceHistoryHash under shared continuity semantics; do not silently redefine either hash.
Resolve and validate the continuity receipt only after the replay window exists.
Require receipt symbol, asOf/marketDate, decision cutoff, exact eligible-session/date set and sourceHistoryHash to match the selected replay window.
Require shared D03 continuity identity/provenance fields.
For the first NC-T01 witness, accept only CLEAR_NO_ACTION over RAW bars. RAW plus ADJUSTED_CONTINUITY must fail closed.
Thread continuityReceiptId/sourceHistoryHash/continuityTransformHash and selected replay-window identity into factor/candidate provenance.
Leave unmatched, missing, late, ambiguous or unresolved continuity as UNVERIFIED/INCOMPLETE.
Do not rewrite immutable historical D1 rows merely to change continuity labels.
Do not create a second corporate-action or technical-indicator continuity engine.

ncT01Binding.bindingRule: Use existing candidateUniverseProvenance/sourceGenerationRefs plus receipt/result hashes to bind immutable continuity and replay references. New top-level structured fields would require a versioned schema change.
